clipped.advice: The lightest 12% of tones print as paper white (the negative blocks them fully): give more exposure, or use a less blocking colour.
The darkest 36% of tones print as full black: give less exposure, or use a more blocking colour.

15% of the highlights print as paper white and 29% of the shadows as full black: the negative's range is longer than the process's. Try a less blocking colour (see the blocking test); meanwhile the curve squeezes those tones into fewer steps.
